lines.t: You are more than the fields that I see
You are more than the filth that covers you
More than the sin that fills you
Much more than the choices you make
For I see your beauty, I know your heart
And the love which you have for me
Behold, I know you as you are
And will be with me where I am
You are not that which you choose
You are that which I have created
And will become that which I restore
Always a beautiful finished work, elect and precious, my everlasting treasure.
Even as I shall be Yours also For I know my own
